name: Romanian Deadlift
common_faults: bending knees excessively (turning it into a squat)

substitutions.note: starts from floor; greater systemic demand
removes hinge/hamstring stretch; isolates glute at lockout

contraindications: hamstring strain in loaded lengthened position
resistance_profile: hardest at the bottom of the hinge where hamstring is fully stretched; decreases toward lockout

provenance.notes: Excellent hamstring stimulus in the lengthened position (high SFR for posterior chain). Fatigue ratings heuristic.
